chunks: (Moses) said: "Our Lord is He who gave everything its natural form and directed it."
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God giving everything its creation and then guiding it?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Taa-Haa is often cited to illustrate the concept of 'Fitrah' (innate nature), where God not only creates the physical form of every entity but also guides it toward its ultimate teleological purpose. It underscores the divine attribute of providing both origin and direction, affirming that guidance is an intrinsic part of creation rather than an external addition.
